title: Time
summary: A moment as the place needs it: today the time, yesterday «вчера, 19:40», tomorrow «завтра, 10:00», then the date, relative within the first hour («только что» under a minute), with the full date, time and zone in a tooltip on hover and keyboard focus, inside a time element; in a list or a feed no Tab stop, the moment in the row's text. The words are the platform's (Intl) in the page language; the element draws itself again when its words change, on one timer for the page.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

datetime.description: The moment, ISO 8601 with its offset (2026-11-09T14:32:00+03:00) or milliseconds. Empty or not a date: the element draws nothing

format.description: auto: within threshold of now relative («28 минут назад», «через 20 минут»; under a minute past «только что», under a minute ahead the language's «сейчас», never seconds), today the time («14:32») or, later today, «сегодня, 14:00», yesterday «вчера, 19:40», tomorrow «завтра, 10:00», a later day its date and time («17 ноября, 10:00»), this year the day and month («5 ноября»), older the date with the year («30 декабря 2025 г.»); time: «14:32»; date: «9 ноября», the year when it is not this one; datetime: the full moment («9 ноября 2026 г. в 14:32»); relative: always relative («только что» under a minute). Every word is Intl's in the page language («gestern, 19:40» on a German page) but «только что», which is the component's (ru, en, and what a product registers; another language says its own «now»)

now.description: The moment auto and relative count from, ISO 8601; empty: the reader's clock, and the element draws itself again when its words change («1 минуту назад» → «2 минуты назад»), at its threshold and at the reader's midnight, on one timer for the whole page that waits while the page is hidden. A fixed now is for tests and documentation

threshold.description: For auto: how long from now the moment stays relative, an ISO 8601 duration (PT1H, PT15M, P1D). Past it auto says the time or the date

time-zone.description: The time zone the moment is written in, an IANA name (Europe/Moscow), for a product that knows the person's zone from their profile; empty or a name the browser does not know: the reader's own zone. The tooltip names the zone either way («…, Москва (UTC+3)»), and today, yesterday and tomorrow are that zone's days (owner decision C183 (3))

tooltip.description: auto: when the text is not the full moment, the full date and time with the zone named («13 ноября 2026 г. в 19:40, Москва (UTC+3)») show in a tooltip on hover and on keyboard focus (Escape hides it). The element is a Tab stop when it stands alone; inside a link, a button, a list item, a feed or a table cell it is not, and the full moment is then a visually hidden part of the row's text, so a screen reader hears it with the row (owner decision C183 (2)); none: no tooltip and no Tab stop (a day heading's date, a place that already says the moment)

forbidden_client_responsibilities: formatting the moment by hand (the words are SF.format's)

keyboard: Tab reaches a time with a tooltip (not inside a link or a button) and shows the full moment; Escape hides it
accessibility.focus: A Tab stop only with a tooltip and outside a link or a button.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-time wherever a moment is shown: a list's or a table's «when», a message's time, «изменено …» in a record head, a file version, a notification.
do_not: Do not format a date by hand next to it; give the moment and choose format
Do not use format relative in a table or a log; auto keeps it to the first hour
Do not put a title attribute on it; the tooltip says the moment
